description: Elections Commission - Declare that S. M. M. Jayanthi Menike was selected as the member of the Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy created when a member ceased to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it deals with electoral procedures and member selection for local government bodies.
